info.title: Buttondown Universal API
info.description: Manage Buttondown newsletters, subscribers, emails, automations, and webhooks through the official Buttondown API.

post.description: Creates a draft email in Buttondown.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

description.description: Internal description for the draft email.

absoluteUrl.description: Resolved absolute URL for the email.

analytics.description: Analytics payload when Buttondown provides one.

body.description: Email body content returned by Buttondown.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL associated with the email.

creationDate.description: When the email was created in Buttondown.

description.description: Internal description stored on the email.

filters.description: Audience filter definition stored on the email.

image.description: Hero image associated with the email.

metadata.description: Structured metadata stored on the email.

modificationDate.description: When the email was last modified in Buttondown.

publishDate.description: When the email is scheduled or published, if applicable.

relatedEmailIds.description: Related email IDs returned by Buttondown.

secondaryId.description: Secondary numeric ID when Buttondown returns one.

shouldTriggerPayPerEmailBilling.description: Whether the email should trigger pay-per-email billing.

suppressionReason.description: Suppression reason when Buttondown returns one.

template.description: Template metadata when Buttondown returns one.

deliveredCount.description: Total delivered email count when available.

emailTransitions.description: Email transition history for the subscriber.

notes.description: Internal notes stored on the subscriber.

riskScore.description: Buttondown firewall risk score when available.

transitions.description: Lifecycle transitions recorded for the subscriber.
